description: Generate and deterministically verify synthetic parametric coding challenges in isolation, returning curated verified solution traces and optionally promoting reusable helper skills. Use for autonomous skill warm-up and trace curation; use `oxyo_verify_python` to check a single snippet.

export_corpus.description: Export the curated verified trace corpus after problem verification.

max_per_family.description: Maximum verified traces retained per problem family during curation.

max_problems.description: Number of synthetic problems to generate and verify in this run (1..8).

promote_skills.description: Automatically register verified reusable helper functions into the skill library.

run_self_play.description: Generate and verify new parametric problems before exporting traces.

seed.description: Optional integer RNG seed for reproducible problem generation.

name: oxyo_self_play_distill
